<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#370d13"/>

      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1677bc"/>
      <stop offset=".5" stop-color="#6ea7d3"/>
